title: Affine diagonal conormal coordinates for one normalized derivation
statement: Let f : X → S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U ⊆ X and V ⊆ S affine opens with U ⊆ f⁻¹(V), A = Γ(X,U), and R = Γ(S,V). For a supplied relative derivation D into the diagonal conormal [def-sc-diagonal-conormal] satisfying the normalization of [lem-sc-diagonal-conormal-derivation-exists], there exists an A-linear equivalence e : Ω[A/R] → Γ(diagonalConormal f,U) [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] with e(da) = D(a) for every a ∈ A. This statement only calculates coordinates for the supplied D; it neither constructs D nor asserts simultaneous compatibility with every normalized derivation.

proof.text: Form the affine ambient open W = U ×_V U = Spec(A ⊗_R A). Its diagonal inverse image is U and the restricted diagonal is closed, induced by multiplication. Restrict the actual module-sheaf kernel and tensor pullback, identifying their restrictions with the restricted diagonal ideal and its conormal. The adjunction units agree under these canonical restriction identifications by uniqueness of mates.

Apply affine_conormal_sections to the restricted closed diagonal. The resulting equivalence from the multiplication ideal cotangent quotient to conormal sections is A-linear through multiplication. Use Mathlib’s identification of KaehlerDifferential with this cotangent quotient.

The actual kernel section corresponding to 1 ⊗ a − a ⊗ 1 has that difference as its image. Apply the affine conormal class-map formula and the supplied normalization hD; KaehlerDifferential.D_apply identifies its cotangent class with da. This proves the coordinate formula for the supplied D.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08S2, 01KJ and 01R3; checked online in the independent second reading on 2026-10-13. For uniqueness, the difference-formula argument is made directly in Lean using the existing sectionwise kernel theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_diagonalConormal_affine_sections_base (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (D : (diagonalConormal f).val.Derivation' f.pullbackPresheafToPresheaf)
    (hD : IsDiagonalConormalDerivation f D) :
    ∃ e : CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential (f.appLE V.1 U.1 hUV) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U.1)]
          Γ(diagonalConormal f, U.1),
        ∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), e (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a) =
          D.d (X := op U.1) a
